versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.

- No file or documentation changes detected. 
- Functionality and usage remain the same as the previous release.

Initial release of classroom-note-translator

- Converts English classroom or lecture audio/video into structured, bilingual Chinese learning notes.
- Supports input from audio, video, or URLs (with media extraction).
- Generates Markdown notes with summaries, key points, terminology, timeline, review questions, and bilingual excerpts.
- Automatic export to Notion or Obsidian vaults is supported.
- Built-in options for speaker separation, timestamps, and output directory.
- Includes raw transcript, structured notes, and bilingual text output files.
